name: LeetSwap WETH/FREN pair fee-transfer drain
summary: LeetSwapV2Pair exposed its fee-transfer helper publicly without caller, token, or amount authorization. An unprivileged caller could move a pair's counterpart-token balance into its fees contract, synchronize the depleted reserve, and drain WETH through the resulting reserve distortion.
notes: LeetSwap factory CREATE2 deployment of this immutable-bearing pair runtime. Archival code is absent in block 2029742 and hashes to 0x11ccaa9724bb0039422598492778dfa22e04be499970a182596605712d6eded6 at deployment and immediately before the incident; the pair has no proxy code-selection path.

The pair sent 15.696794587395952794 WETH to the attack helper across two pair-specific drain transactions. Excluding the helper's two identifiable 0.001 WETH setup-swap inputs leaves exact pre-recovery victim depletion of 15.694794587395952794 WETH, valued at DefiLlama's nearest observation of $1,863.01. The public fee-transfer calls also moved the counterpart token into the pair's fees contract; those internal transfers are excluded because claim allocation and recoverability cannot be isolated from the receipts, so no speculative counterpart-token value is assigned.
This pair-specific record is part of a coordinated same-attacker LeetSwap umbrella. Loss is partitioned by pair deployment and is not duplicated across sibling records.
